pages.lesson:
LESSON: SUNNAH PRAYERS QABLIYAH AND BA'DIYAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should a Muslim perform Qabliya and Ba’diyah?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah
2. appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SUNNAH PRAYERS QABLIYAH AND BA'DIYAH
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SUNNAH PRAYERS QABLIYAH AND BA'DIYAH
Study Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.). Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah in your own words. (skill: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.))

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).
4. Make one local Kenya example of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim perform Qabliya and Ba’diyah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: perform Qabliyah and Ba’diyah prayers to earn rewards from Allah.
5. Be able to: appreciate the performance of Qabliyah and Ba’diyah to emulate the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.).

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
